description: ROM Ali Water Combat Ripple Physics & Air Dive

routines.name: ali_ripple_impulse_callback
routines.purpose: Directional water ripple velocity calculation (speeds 0x800/0x780, vz = 0x20000)

routines.name: ali_weapon_durability_table
routines.purpose: Weapon element / durability index lookup [0, 1, 0xFFFF, 0x2003] with random 1..6

routines.name: ali_water_dagger_strike_frame8
routines.purpose: Water dagger strike at frame 8 with SFX 0x800223 and ripple mode 6

routines.name: ali_dagger_somersault_high_dive
routines.purpose: High dive impulse 0x80000 at frame 36, SFX 0x500341, 0xC000 gravity, landing timer 0x48

routines.name: ali_target_hitstun_callback
routines.purpose: Clears target horizontal speed and applies 12-frame hitstun timer +0x83 = 0x0C
